classification.difficultyReason: Same structure as p20-q13: two oppositely directed launches, flight times and ranges for each, and a signed landing position measured from one origin. The numbers are slightly kinder, but the crossing-over decisions are the same.

content.prompt: Two balls are thrown at the same time from points on level ground, and travel towards each other. Use $g=10\text{ m s}^{-2}$. How far apart do the balls land? Give your answers to 1 d.p.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Ball A is thrown from $P$ at $20\text{ m s}^{-1}$ at $60^\circ$. Ball B is thrown from $Q$, which is $50\text{ m}$ from $P$, at $20\text{ m s}^{-1}$ at $45^\circ$.

answer.worked:
Take $P$ as $x=0$, with positive $x$ towards $Q$.
For ball A:
$$\begin{align*}y_A&=20\sin60^\circ\,t-5t^2\\0&=t(10\sqrt3-5t)\\t_A&=2\sqrt3\text{ s}\\x_A&=20\cos60^\circ(2\sqrt3)\\&=20\sqrt3\text{ m}\end{align*}$$For ball B, the horizontal velocity is negative:
$$\begin{align*}y_B&=20\sin45^\circ\,t-5t^2\\0&=t(10\sqrt2-5t)\\t_B&=2\sqrt2\text{ s}\\x_B&=50-20\cos45^\circ(2\sqrt2)\\&=50-40\\&=10\text{ m}\end{align*}$$$$\begin{align*}d&=20\sqrt3-10\\&\approx24.6\text{ m}\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Ball A is thrown from $P$ at $20\text{ m s}^{-1}$ at $30^\circ$. Ball B is thrown from $Q$, which is $40\text{ m}$ from $P$, at $20\text{ m s}^{-1}$ at $60^\circ$.

answer.worked:
Take $P$ as $x=0$, with positive $x$ towards $Q$.
For ball A:
$$\begin{align*}y_A&=20\sin30^\circ\,t-5t^2\\0&=5t(2-t)\\t_A&=2\text{ s}\\x_A&=20\cos30^\circ(2)\\&=20\sqrt3\text{ m}\end{align*}$$For ball B, the horizontal velocity is negative:
$$\begin{align*}y_B&=20\sin60^\circ\,t-5t^2\\0&=t(10\sqrt3-5t)\\t_B&=2\sqrt3\text{ s}\\x_B&=40-20\cos60^\circ(2\sqrt3)\\&=40-20\sqrt3\text{ m}\end{align*}$$$$\begin{align*}d&=20\sqrt3-(40-20\sqrt3)\\&=40\sqrt3-40\\&\approx29.3\text{ m}\end{align*}$$
